name: Playboi Carti
label: AWGE / Interscope
lede: An Atlanta kid who freestyles nearly every verse turns a baby voice, long silences and a vampire alter ego into the records rage rap is built on.

eras.title: Sir Cartier skips class
eras.text: A basketball kid from South Atlanta starts recording at a friend's house instead of going to school. By 2015 he has a new name, a SoundCloud following and a ticket to New York.

years.src: The Fader: The Secret Life of Playboi Carti · Wikipedia: Playboi Carti
years.h: Jordan Carter is born in Atlanta the day Tupac dies
years.p: The Fader gives his birthday as September 13, 1996; other sources say 1995. He grows up in South Atlanta and Riverdale with basketball as the plan.
years.xp: Basketball was the main thing until he quit after a disagreement with a coach, per Wikipedia. His older brother brought home the Atlanta rap, Gucci Mane first. He was also, by his own account, a thrift store kid, and among the first in his neighborhood in skinny jeans, skating at the Historic Fourth Ward Skatepark.

years.src: Wikipedia: Playboi Carti · The Fader: The Secret Life of Playboi Carti
years.h: Awful Records takes in the former Sir Cartier
years.p: Producer Ethereal brings him into the Atlanta collective run by Father, and Carti credits Ethereal with shaping his sound.
years.xp: He started in 2011 as Sir Cartier, skipping class to record at a friend's house and putting out two projects under that name, The Fader reports. His first upload as Playboi Carti, "YUNGXANHOE," samples the PlayStation 2 startup sound, The Fader notes. Early videos made him easy to spot: an oval birthmark on his left cheek.

years.h: "Broke Boi" carries him out of Atlanta
years.p: "Broke Boi" and "Fetti," with Dash and Maxo Kream, spread on SoundCloud while he runs with [[Lil Yachty|a668565b-41b8-44a8-9d5c-8e609dbf69fc]], UnoTheActivist and Thouxanbanfauni.

years.src: The Fader: The Secret Life of Playboi Carti · Wikipedia: Playboi Carti
years.h: At 18, Carti moves to New York and finds the A$AP Mob
years.p: He crashes with family and friends, falls in with A$AP Bari and stylist Ian Connor in SoHo, and is introduced to [[A$AP Rocky|25b7b584-d952-4662-a8b9-dd8cdfbfeb64]] at SXSW 2015.

eras.title: A$AP Rocky makes a call
eras.text: A$AP Rocky puts Carti on AWGE, his imprint at Interscope, and hands him to a South Carolina producer named Pi'erre Bourne. One mixtape later, the ad-libs are the song.

years.src: Wikipedia: Playboi Carti · The Fader: The Secret Life of Playboi Carti
years.h: AWGE and Interscope sign Playboi Carti
years.p: A$AP Rocky's imprint makes it official, and Carti goes on the road opening for A$AP Ferg on the Turnt & Burnt Tour.

years.h: Playboi Carti arrives with Pi'erre Bourne at the controls
years.p: Pi'erre Bourne produces nearly half of it and Rocky executive produces. It debuts at No. 12 on the Billboard 200 and goes platinum in 2020.
years.xp:
Harry Fraud, Southside, Hit-Boy and Jake One fill in the rest, from sessions in Los Angeles, Atlanta and New York. First week: 28,000 album-equivalent units.

Jon Caramanica of The New York Times wrote that it "takes hip-hop's ad-lib era to its logical extreme."

years.src: Wikipedia: Playboi Carti · Wikipedia: Lil Uzi Vert
years.h: "Wokeuplikethis" pairs him with Lil Uzi Vert
years.p: The song with [[Lil Uzi Vert|8837b875-3689-4646-b3fd-d8b53815c7a8]] reaches No. 76, and the two share the stage at Coachella that month.

years.cap: Carti at the Phoenix Concert Theatre, Toronto, August 2017
years.h: XXL puts him on its Freshman cover
years.p: Carti makes the 2017 class next to XXXTentacion, A Boogie wit da Hoodie, Ugly God and PnB Rock.

years.h: "Magnolia" gets a video and a life of its own
years.p: The Pi'erre Bourne beat peaks at No. 29 on the Hot 100 and Pitchfork names it Best New Track. Hidji Films directs the clip.

eras.title: The baby voice
eras.text: Die Lit lands without warning and with almost no radio. Then Carti goes quiet on his own records while the leaks pile up and his voice keeps showing up on everyone else's.

years.h: A tour stop in Gretna, Scotland ends in a conviction
years.p: Carti assaults a tour bus driver there; in January 2019 a Scottish court fines him £800.

years.src: Wikipedia: Die Lit · XXL: Playboi Carti surprises fans
years.h: Die Lit drops with no warning, first on Tidal
years.p: Pi'erre Bourne produces 15 of the 19 tracks. It debuts at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 with 61,000 units.
years.xp:
Recorded in Atlanta between December 2017 and March 2018, often five or six songs a session. Guests include Skepta, [[Travis Scott|e4a51f17-a57b-47b1-b37b-f552d0f8e9e6]], Lil Uzi Vert, [[Nicki Minaj|1036b808-f58c-4a3e-b461-a2c4492ecf1b]], [[Chief Keef|9118f524-be76-4eaf-875c-ccf15e2a2ad6]] and [[Young Thug|800760de-bdf8-43a2-8fe0-44a2401a5515]].

Nick Walker's cover photo catches Carti diving into a crowd. Fans decided a man in it was [[Dave Grohl|4d5f891d-9bce-45ae-ad86-912dd27252fa]]; it was actor Francisco Marcano, who then turned up in the "R.I.P." video. Pitchfork's Evan Rytlewski called the album "a perversely infectious sugar high." After the summer Die Lit Tour, he announced the next one, Whole Lotta Red, in August. It took until Christmas 2020.

years.h: Leaked "Pissy Pamper" racks up tens of millions of plays
years.p: No new Carti album, so unreleased songs fill the gap. "Pissy Pamper" spreads through unofficial uploads.

years.h: Solange and Tyler borrow the baby voice
years.p: The high, frantic delivery shows up on Solange's "Almeda" and on [[Tyler, the Creator|f6beac20-5dfe-4d1f-ae02-0b0a740aafd6]]'s "Earfquake."

years.h: Opium opens in Atlanta
years.p: Carti starts his own label, dark and punk-minded, later home to [[Ken Carson|860d7dc2-618d-437e-a3bb-7b91c2d40095]], [[Destroy Lonely|987d3d86-0d7a-4292-ae96-a8d59e456436]] and Homixide Gang.

q: I just want people to take me serious.
years.src: The Fader: The Secret Life of Playboi Carti
years.h: The Fader finds Carti recording at his dining-room table
years.p: In his Buckhead house, shared with [[Iggy Azalea|3a052c99-8c18-484a-8beb-9873b4fb3106]], he records at a wooden table, and says he has about 50 songs for Whole Lotta Red.
years.xp:
The bigger sessions happen at [[DJ Drama|de23d637-20df-4b15-ae63-263dd5a34f10]]'s Means Street Studios in northwest Atlanta, with engineer Roark Bailey. Ben Dandridge-Lemco's cover story catches him barely using social media and loving vampire movies, The Lost Boys and Interview with the Vampire.

He told The Fader: "I might make the hardest song ever tomorrow."

eras.title: Whole Lotta Red, Christmas morning
eras.text: An arrest, a first top ten and a son come before the album. When it lands, fans are split down the middle; within a few years critics credit it with defining rage.

years.h: "@ Meh" drops, and Clayton County police pull him over
years.p: The single reaches No. 35. That same month a traffic stop turns up guns and drugs; he is out on bond the next morning.
years.xp: Wikipedia lists what police found: 12 bags of marijuana, three guns, Xanax, codeine and oxycodone. The charges included expired tags, marijuana possession and improper passing of an emergency vehicle.

years.h: Drake's "Pain 1993" gives him a first top ten
years.p: The track from [[Drake|9fff2f8a-21e6-47de-a2b8-7f449929d43f]]'s Dark Lane Demo Tapes debuts at No. 7 on the Hot 100.

years.h: Iggy Azalea gives birth to their son, Onyx
years.p: The couple had split in December 2019. Azalea later said publicly that Carti has no relationship with the boy.

years.src: Wikipedia: Whole Lotta Red · Rolling Stone: Playboi Carti Whole Lotta Red
years.h: Whole Lotta Red finally lands on Christmas Day
years.p: Kanye West and Matthew Williams executive produce; F1lthy and Art Dealer build most of it. It is his first No. 1 album.
years.xp:
Recorded from 2018 to November 2020 at his Buckhead home, Means Street Studios and West Lake Ranch in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. Kanye, Kid Cudi and [[Future|48262e82-db9f-4a92-b650-dfef979b73ec]] are the only guests. The cover nods to Slash, the 1970s punk zine, and its issue with [[The Damned|77d21c13-846f-4f48-9546-873949eff6ae]]'s Dave Vanian.

The first reaction was polarized. By 2024 Pitchfork ranked it No. 2 on its list of the best albums of the 2020s so far, and Wikipedia credits it with defining rage.

years.src: Rolling Stone: Playboi Carti runs riot
years.h: Carti runs riot through a grocery store in "Sky"
years.p: The Whole Lotta Red video takes the album's punk energy into the aisles.

years.cap: Carti at State Farm Arena, Atlanta, December 2021
q: Vampires is the most fashionable characters.
years.src: Rolling Stone: Playboi Carti Whole Lotta Red
years.h: Candy-red braids and a vampire alter ego
years.p: Rolling Stone finds him barely sleeping and in the studio nearly every day. "Vamp Anthem" samples Bach's "Toccata and Fugue in D Minor."

years.h: Narcissist is announced for his birthday, and the date passes
years.p: He names the album and sets September 13. Nothing comes out. Instead he raps on three songs on Kanye's Donda, including "Off the Grid."

years.cap: King Vamp Tour, State Farm Arena, Atlanta, December 23, 2021
years.src: Wikipedia: Whole Lotta Red · Wikipedia: Playboi Carti
years.h: Carti takes the vampire on the road: the King Vamp Tour
years.p: Planned as the Narcissist Tour, it runs across North America from October 14 to December 23.

eras.title: Opium's boss, everyone's feature
eras.text: Carti spends the gap executive producing his label's acts and lending a new deep voice to other people's hits. The singles for the next album arrive one at a time on Instagram.

years.h: Carti executive produces Ken Carson's X
years.p: The Opium signee's album carries the label's sound, and the boss's name on the credits.

years.src: XXL: Playboi Carti arrested in December · Wikipedia: Playboi Carti
years.h: XXL reports a December arrest for choking his pregnant girlfriend
years.p: The fight was over paternity testing, according to the report. He was released on bond a day later.

years.h: The growl arrives on Travis Scott's "Fein"
years.p: His Utopia feature shows off a coarse new deep voice. That same month he debuts "Pop Out" at London's Wireless Festival.

years.h: "Different Day" opens the I Am Music rollout
years.p: It goes up on Opium's Instagram with a video, followed by "2024," "H00dByAir," "Backr00ms" with Travis Scott and "EvilJ0rdan."

years.h: "Carnival" becomes his first No. 1 single
years.p: The song from Kanye West and Ty Dolla Sign's Vultures 1 tops the Hot 100. The same month he joins Travis Scott on the Grammys stage.

years.src: Wikipedia: Playboi Carti · Wikipedia: Music (Playboi Carti album)
years.h: "All Red" ends four years without a solo streaming release
years.p: It is his first since "@ Meh." Days earlier the album gets its final title, Music, and he joins [[The Weeknd|c8b03190-306c-4120-bb0b-6f2ebfc06ea9]] on "Timeless."

years.h: Five new songs at Rolling Loud Miami
years.p: Three months before release, he tests the album live on the festival's home turf.

eras.title: Thirty tracks, all charting
eras.text: The album finally lands, hours late, and every song on it hits the Hot 100. Then Carti takes Opium on the road.

years.h: Music shows up at 7:30 a.m., and all 30 songs chart
years.p: Sample clearances push it past midnight. It debuts at No. 1 with 298,000 units, and he becomes the first rapper with 30 songs on the Hot 100 at once.
years.xp:
Guests include Travis Scott, The Weeknd, [[Kendrick Lamar|381086ea-f511-4aba-bdf9-71c753dc5077]], Jhené Aiko, Skepta, Future and Lil Uzi Vert. It did 134 million Spotify streams on day one.

A deluxe edition, Music – Sorry 4 da Wait, followed on March 25 with four more songs.

years.h: Canada turns him away, and he misses three Weeknd dates
years.p: Carti is opening The Weeknd's After Hours til Dawn Tour when he is denied entry, scrapping his sets on July 15, 16 and 19.

years.h: Utah prosecutors charge him with assault
years.p: The charge stems from a tour stop where he allegedly punched a limousine driver, Carl Reynolds, in the face.

years.src: Wikipedia: Playboi Carti · Wikipedia: Music (Playboi Carti album)
years.h: The Antagonist Tour brings Opium with him
years.p: Ken Carson, Destroy Lonely, Homixide Gang and ApolloRed1 support through December 1. The tour had first been planned for 2023.
